messages.text: Client wants to hedge about 12mm EUR receivable coming in end of September. Thinking 3m fwd vs rolling spots. Anyone have a view on carry here?
Fwd points are working in their favor if they're selling EUR, so locking in 3m is fine. Rolling spots just adds ticket risk and slippage.
@Jonathan what's the hedge ratio they asked for? Full notional or partial? Don't want to over-hedge if the invoice timing slips.
They said 75% now, rest later once the invoice is confirmed. Staged approach.
Good. 75% fwd now, leave the remainder open. Jessica, can you run a quick sensitivity on the unhedged 25%?
On it. Using 1m implied vol, a 1 sigma move on the unhedged piece is roughly 40k USD P&L swing over the horizon. Will drop the full table in a sec.
Liquidity is decent right now, London still around. I can work the fwd in clips if we want to stay out of the way of the 2pm data.
Yes, clip it. Keep it under the client's slippage tolerance. Get the order staged in OMS and tag it to the hedge program.
Staged in OMS, parent order is in. Tagged as client hedge, not prop. Steven, it's yours.
Got first clip done, 4mm at mid plus 0.8 pips. Working the other 5mm, will update.
Sensitivity table is up in the shared folder. Also noticed TradeBlotter is showing the fwd points in the wrong sign on the new ticket. Is that display only?
Display only I think, booking is right in OMS. Jonathan, flag it to Tech after we finish the fill, and double check the confirm before it goes out.
